capabilities: Add, slide, and rotate mirror guide axes on the canvas
Mirror strokes live while drawing across one or more guides
Build radial symmetry with two guides producing up to 8 sectors
Mirror existing elements via Ctrl+Click or a one-shot mirror command
Configure whether undo removes the stroke and its mirrors together or separately
disambiguation: Not a file or vault mirroring tool; it adds symmetry guide axes inside Excalidraw drawings.
extras: Manual installation only (install script, manual file copy, or build from source); the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; fully local with no network requests; requires Obsidian desktop 1.5.0+.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a companion and does nothing without it.
motivation: The author was drawing anatomy notes (muscle fibers around an iris) and needed dozens of mirrored freehand strokes, which was slow and inaccurate by hand.
problem: Excalidraw has no mirror or symmetry mode, so drawing symmetric figures in Obsidian requires slow manual copy, flip and paste work.

relations.evidence: The official Excalidraw plugin installed and enabled. This plugin is a companion and does nothing without it.
Vector tools like Krita and Procreate have mirror or symmetry drawing: you place an axis

summary: Companion plugin for the official Excalidraw plugin that adds mirror guides for live symmetry drawing and radial symmetry on the canvas.
